schema_review.rationale: Register the complete 1.3.0 no-vector, Code-disabled Server chain on all three backends, preserving history, existing Source references and pending intents with projection rebuilds and read-only startup admission. Review master 464cd152: the Atomic Memory snapshot budget changes admission and buffering, preserving the snapshot digest and frozen schema/revision resources. SQLite legacy tag maintenance creates the final table name directly to preserve canonical DDL, tag rows and transactional rollback. New revision s1401 registers the frozen offline Memory archive on all three backends through the shared chain; s1300/s1400 resources and checksums remain unchanged, and archived history is preserved. Publication requires installed-release upgrade, repeat-apply, old-startup rejection, background Worker execution and fresh-schema equivalence. Optional vector/Code and older Memory layouts need separately registered profiles. Managed Processing mode maintenance uses the canonical target lock, backup providers and durable evidence without changing pc_schema_revision or frozen migration resources. Its reviewed plan binds configuration and migration ID; one transaction publishes the mode and lease invalidation, and interrupted retries reuse the original recovery point. Compatibility commands delegate current managed Server storage and reject complete unversioned historical Server storage before domain writes; unmanaged domain behavior is retained. Atomic legacy maintenance/projection delegation is still required before framework activation.
